# Feature: Hidden orb — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #16 (Hidden orb) from Orbs before it is used in real levels. Effect: only visible inside your light radius. Unique: invisible because of light, not because it is disguised. Useful: makes searching, not routing, the puzzle in the dark. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** only visible inside your light radius.

**So that** makes searching, not routing, the puzzle in the dark.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Hidden orb for the first time in its teaching room (mech-16-hidden-orb-room). Teaching moment: First room: a dark room whose gate needs an orb that sits outside the entrance light. A player who walks the obvious lit route reaches the gate with the counter still showing one and has to return, which teaches that an orb can be present without being visible and that the room is searched by walking the light through it. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: In a dark room the orb is simply not drawn outside your light radius
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Entering the radius reveals it for as long as it is lit, so searching is walking the room, not guessing a route

## Edge Cases & Rules

- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Hidden orb's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-16-hidden-orb-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/orbs.yml mechanic #16.
